notes: Tail case. U1/U2 were person-level edits in a dense crowd -> garments with v2 garment masks; U3 'remove the roof' was ill-posed and ambiguous -> retargeted remove to the white peaked tent in front of the scaffolding; U4 dome ref and flag payload made specific.

difficulty.scene_zh: 脚手架包裹的市政厅前草坪人群
difficulty.evidence_zh: 右下戴灰色鸭舌帽男子的黑T恤、双手叉腰站立男子的深蓝长袖上衣、脚手架前的白色尖顶帐篷和中央塔楼的绿色铜圆顶是四个不同对象。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留建筑、人物和广场环境。

spec.ref: the black T-shirt of the seated man in a grey flat cap at the lower right

units.ref_zh: 右下方戴灰色鸭舌帽坐着的男子的黑色T恤
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将右下方戴灰色鸭舌帽坐着的男子的黑色T恤的颜色改为蓝色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为蓝色。
units.reason: Person-level recolor in a crowd; now the T-shirt, v2 mask = T-shirt only (arms, cap, trousers excluded).

spec.ref: the navy long-sleeve top of the man standing with hands on hips near the center

units.ref_zh: 中间附近双手叉腰站立的男子的深蓝色长袖上衣
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将中间附近双手叉腰站立的男子的深蓝色长袖上衣替换为一件红色连帽雨衣。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一件红色连帽雨衣。
units.reason: Person replaced by a coat; now the top is replaced by a different garment, v2 mask = top only.

spec.ref: the white peaked tent in front of the scaffolded building

units.ref_zh: 脚手架建筑前的白色尖顶帐篷
units.instruction_ref_zh: 移除脚手架建筑前的白色尖顶帐篷。
units.reason: Removing a building roof strip is physically absurd and the ref was ambiguous with the far-left roof; retargeted the remove to the only white tent (visible canopy; people in front excluded).

spec.ref: the green copper dome of the central tower
spec.payload: one small red-and-white flag on a short pole

units.ref_zh: 中央塔楼的绿色铜圆顶
units.instruction_ref_zh: 在中央塔楼的绿色铜圆顶上加上一面插在短杆上的红白小旗。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 在选中区域上加上一面插在短杆上的红白小旗。
units.reason: Payload made specific; ref names the central tower's dome (side towers have small green spires, not this dome).
